## Sample Review: Notion vs Obsidian for Daily Knowledge Work

- URL: https://getproductreview.com/reviews/sample-review
- Author: Gelei
- Published: 2026-05-15
- Category: Productivity software
- Rating: 7.5 / 10 (Obsidian)

A six-month head-to-head between two leading personal knowledge management apps. The verdict, briefly: Obsidian wins on long-term portability and retrieval; Notion wins on collaborative editing and first-30-day onboarding. Which one is right depends on whether your notes are mostly for you or mostly for a team.

See the full review at https://getproductreview.com/reviews/sample-review for methodology, comparison tables, and the deciding factors.
